Based on my search, here's information about Welch Allyn ophthalmology tools:

## Overview

Welch Allyn (now part of Hillrom) is a leading manufacturer of diagnostic instruments founded in 1915, when Dr. Francis A. Welch and William Noah Allyn introduced the first handheld, direct-illuminating ophthalmoscope. The company pioneered several important advances in medical diagnostic instruments, including fiber optics for otoscopes, halogen HPX lamps, and coaxial vision systems for direct ophthalmoscopes.

## Key Ophthalmology Tools

### Ophthalmoscopes

Welch Allyn offers three main ophthalmoscope models:

| Feature | Traditional Model | Basic PanOptic | PanOptic Plus |
|---------|-----------------|---------------|---------------|
| Field of View | Standard | 20x Larger | 20x Larger |
| DuraShock Technology | No | Yes | Yes |
| Digital Image Capture | No | No | Yes |
| Cobalt Blue Filter | No | No | Yes |
| Warranty | 1 Year | 1 Year | 5 Years |

**PanOptic Plus LED Ophthalmoscope** — Their flagship model featuring:
- 25-degree field of vision (20x larger than standard coaxial ophthalmoscopes)
- Quick Eye alignment technology for better optic disc alignment
- DuraShock technology for impact resistance
- Long-lasting LED lamps
- Digital image capture capability
- Compatible with 3.5V power sources and Li-ion handles

**PanOptic Basic LED Ophthalmoscope** — Offers excellent optics with LED illumination and a 20x larger field of view at a more moderate price point.

**Coaxial Ophthalmoscope** — Traditional design with good optics, available in more budget-friendly diagnostic sets.

### Diagnostic Sets

Welch Allyn ophthalmology tools are typically sold in comprehensive diagnostic sets that include:

- Ophthalmoscope (various models)
- Otoscope (MacroView or standard)
- Rechargeable power handle (Lithium-Ion or NiCad)
- Hard carrying case

Popular configurations include:
- **71PM3LXE-US** — PanOptic Plus with MacroView Plus LED, Premium Li-Ion USB handle (premium)
- **71PM2LXU-US** — PanOptic Basic with MacroView Basic LED, Li-Ion Plus handle (mid-range)
- **71SM2CXX** — Coaxial with MacroView Basic LED, NiCad handle (budget)
- **71SS2CXX** — Standard ophthalmoscope and otoscope, NiCad handle (entry-level)

### Other Ophthalmology Equipment

- **Retinoscopes** — For objective refraction
- **SureSight Vision Screener** — Automatic refractor for pediatric vision screening that quickly checks for glasses prescriptions without requiring patient response

## Advanced Features

- **Digital Integration**: The PanOptic Plus and MacroView Plus can connect to Hillrom's iExaminer Pro App for image capture, documentation, and telemedicine consultations
- **Fiber-Optic Illumination**: Shadow-free lighting for better visibility
- **Quick Eye Technology**: Helps direct patient gaze for better optic disc alignment
- **LumiView Clear Ear Speculum**: Provides 4x more brightness than standard specula (on otoscopes)

## Clinical Applications

Welch Allyn ophthalmology tools are used for:
- Fundoscopic examinations (retina, optic disc, blood vessels)
- Corneal assessments (with cobalt blue filter on PanOptic Plus)
- Detection of systemic diseases affecting small blood vessels and nervous system
- Pediatric vision screening
- Routine eye exams in primary care, emergency departments, urgent care, and specialty clinics

Sources:
1. https://cornellsurgical.com/blogs/default-blog/diagnostic-sets-full-comparison-guide?srsltid=AfmBOoo4mJTylX-gl2NUkWpvAANAodyPMHR19BSdX49ibOtoN8Nz_GUQ
2. https://angelusmedical.com/blogs/guide/what-is-a-welch-allyn-otoscope-used-for?srsltid=AfmBOoqm1PP7F8WoEUD8oMzWJqOh9-8bIOREgA8J9UsJWs_lwgwPax1U
3. https://www.dispomed.com/welch-allyn-ophthalmoscope-purchase-guide/

6. https://www.techsciresearch.com/blog/product-review-new-welch-allyn-panoptic-plus-ophthalmoscope-and-welch-allyn-macroview-plus-otoscope/213.html
7. https://puddelklubb.no/reviews/product/200458
8. https://www.lepekemedical.com/post/product-review-welch-allyn-3-5v-diagnostic-set
